papers.title: Letting Models Manage Their Own Context: Where We Stand
papers.desc: Agent harnesses today manage context on the model's behalf: when the window fills, the harness triggers a compaction that summarizes the history.

papers.title: Demystifying the Autoresearch Harness: How Context and Skills Shape Self-Evolving Agents
papers.desc: Autoresearch agents, which autonomously design, run, and refine experiments, are accelerating scientific progress, particularly in AI research.

papers.title: Single-Database Rewards Are Hackable: Counterfactual Execution for Trustworthy Text-to-SQL RL
papers.desc: Reinforcement learning (RL) for text-to-SQL agents pays a query when its result matches the reference on one database.

papers.title: Entangle: Scaling Human-Video In-Context World-Action Models across Unseen Tasks and Contexts
papers.desc: In-context learning (ICL) enables foundation models to perform unseen tasks from context without parameter updates.

papers.title: Evaluation-Free Recursive Self-Improvement for Coding Agents
papers.desc: Recent self-improving coding agents have achieved strong benchmark performance by iteratively modifying their own executable implementations.

papers.title: Lost in Translation, Not in Confidence: Benchmarking and Calibrating Multilingual Decision Models
papers.desc: Decision models are language models fine-tuned to return a probability for each option of a typed query, which routers and guardrails threshold directly.

papers.title: When Every Rollout Fails: Splicing Learner-Conditioned Options into Long-Horizon Agent RL
papers.desc: Group-based reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards often yields all-fail groups on long-horizon agent tasks: every sampled trajectory receives zero reward, leaving group-relative methods without a reward-based policy gradient.

papers.title: AIChipBench: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Automated AI Accelerator Design
papers.desc: A language-model decoder carries state between decoding steps, and in hardware a wrong state update can leave the current token correct and corrupt the output several tokens later, so a design can pass output tests and still be wrong.

papers.title: WorldBridge: Bridging Scattered Views for Coherent 3D World Generation
papers.desc: Generating coherent and explorable 3D worlds from scattered images with little or no visual overlap is a fundamental and long-standing challenge in computer vision, which existing geometry-aware methods fail to address.

papers.title: Edit Recommendation: Can LLMs Anticipate Edit Requests from Users, and When?
papers.desc: After a large language model (LLM) agent generates an artifact, users often send edit requests for it.

papers.title: When Does Reasoning Help Entity Disambiguation? Small LLMs In-Domain and Under Shift
papers.desc: Entity disambiguation (mapping ambiguous mentions in text to entities in a knowledge base) is a foundational step in tasks such as knowledge graph construction, question answering, and information extraction.

papers.title: Efficient Video Retrieval Augmented Generation via Token Allocation
papers.desc: Efficient long-video understanding requires identifying relevant evidence while minimizing the tokens processed by vision-language models (VLMs).

papers.title: Look Back: Reinforcement Learning with Counterfactual World Models
papers.desc: Agents in complex, stochastic environments must contend with dynamics that can exceed their world models' predictive capacity and randomness that obscure the consequences of their actions.

papers.title: GOLD-SLAM: Gaussian-splatting Omnidirectional LiDAR-Depth SLAM
papers.desc: Panoramic cameras capture nearly the entire spherical field of view in a single frame.

papers.title: Simulator-as-Proxy World Model for Robot Manipulation
papers.desc: Video world models for robots are increasingly conditioned on a simulated or rendered proxy of the scene, on the assumption that the video will show what the proxy shows.
